description: Bleed damage buff with 8 distinct damage calculation types. Deals damage on begin, supports crit, armor, boss damage, and clamping. Interacts with EXTRA_DAMAGE, GIANT_SLAYER, VAMPIRE, and RECORD_DAMAGE systems.

param1.description: Bleed type (0-6, 10). Determines the damage formula used.

param2.description: AttribDefine ID used for type 10 (attribute-based bleed)

param3.description: If 1, type 10 reads attribute from target instead of caster

param5.description: Array of [minMultiplier, maxMultiplier] for damage clamping based on base ATK damage. Empty = no clamp.

skillPar: Passed multiplier from buff application (used as damage coefficient in several types)

type_0.name: Normal ATK Bleed
type_0.formula: baseDamage = max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1); damage = round(baseDamage * ATK_DAM); damage = round(damage * getSkillFactAttrValue(skillPar, skillId, active_skilldamage_par)); if target is Boss and BOSS_DAM > 0: damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + BOSS_DAM)); finalDamage = calHurt(damage, target, caster)

type_1.name: Target Current HP% Bleed
type_1.formula: baseDamage = round(target.currentHp * skillPar); damage = round(baseDamage * injuryReduce)
type_1.notes: Does NOT interact with EXTRA_DAMAGE (special exemption at line 192829)

type_2.name: Skill Damage Bleed
type_2.formula: baseDamage = max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1); damage = roundInt(baseDamage * SKILL_DAM_EXTRA * skillPar); resistPar = calArmorAndBlock(target, caster, SKILL_RESIST, skill_resist); damage = calHurt(roundInt(damage * max(0, round(1 - resistPar))), target, caster); if checkSkillCrit(caster): damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + SKILL_CRIT_DAM)); damage = roundInt(pow(damage, 0.98)); healthType = Hurt_Bleed_Crit

type_3.name: Normal ATK Bleed with Armor + Crit
type_3.formula: baseDamage = max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1); damage = round(baseDamage * ATK_DAM); damage = round(damage * getSkillFactAttrValue(skillPar, skillId, active_skilldamage_par)); if target is Boss and BOSS_DAM > 0: damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + BOSS_DAM)); resistPar = calArmorAndBlock(target, caster, ATT_RESIST, skill_resist); finalDamage = calHurt(roundInt(damage * max(0, round(1 - resistPar))), target, caster); if checkHit == Cirt: critMul = max(1.5, round(CRIT_DAM / max(0.5, CRIT_DEF))); finalDamage = roundInt(finalDamage * critMul); healthType = Hurt_Bleed_Crit

type_4.name: Double Hit Bleed
type_4.formula: baseDamage = max(roundInt(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)) * DOUBLE_HIT_DAM), 1); damage = round(baseDamage * getSkillFactAttrValue(skillPar, skillId, active_skilldamage_par)); if target is Boss and BOSS_DAM > 0: damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + BOSS_DAM)); resistPar = calArmorAndBlock(target, caster, DOUBLE_HIT_DEF, double_hit_def); finalDamage = calHurt(roundInt(damage * max(0, round(1 - resistPar))), target, caster); if checkHit == Cirt: critMul = max(1.5, round(CRIT_DAM / max(0.5, CRIT_DEF))); finalDamage *= critMul

type_5.name: Counter Bleed
type_5.formula: baseDamage = max(roundInt(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)) * COUNTER_DAM), 1); damage = round(baseDamage * getSkillFactAttrValue(skillPar, skillId, active_skilldamage_par)); if target is Boss and BOSS_DAM > 0: damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + BOSS_DAM)); resistPar = calArmorAndBlock(target, caster, COUNTER_DEF, counter_def); finalDamage = calHurt(roundInt(damage * max(0, round(1 - resistPar))), target, caster); if checkHit == Cirt: critMul = max(1.5, round(CRIT_DAM / max(0.5, CRIT_DEF))); finalDamage *= critMul

type_6.name: Target Max HP% Bleed
type_6.formula: baseDamage = round(target.getAttrib(hp) * skillPar); damage = round(baseDamage * injuryReduce)

type_10.name: Attribute-based Bleed
type_10.formula: baseDamage = (_isTarget ? target : caster).getAttrib(_attribId); damage = round(baseDamage * skillPar); damage = round(damage * injuryReduce)

damageClamping.description: When _limit array is non-empty [min, max], damage is clamped to [baseDMG * min, baseDMG * max]
damageClamping.formula: baseDMG = roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1) * ATK_DAM); clampMin = roundInt(baseDMG * limit[0]); clampMax = roundInt(baseDMG * limit[1]); damage = clamp(damage, clampMin, clampMax)
damageClamping.type6_special: For type 6 with Partner units: uses parent ATK, and ATK_DAM is multiplied by partner_dam * partner_dam_extra

postDamageInteractions.EXTRA_DAMAGE: Applied to all types except type 1. Multiplies final damage via ExtraDamage buffs on caster.
postDamageInteractions.RECORD_DAMAGE: Adds recordDamage bonus: damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + round(recordDamage / 10000)))
postDamageInteractions.GIANT_SLAYER: Applied only to type 0. Applies HP-difference bonus damage.
postDamageInteractions.VAMPIRE: Triggers life steal for matching caster/parent. Passes final clamped damage.
